Donald Trump’s midterm election setback has raised hopes of reduced tensions between the US and Iran, triggering a sharp fall in global crude oil prices. But will cheaper crude translate into lower petrol and diesel prices in India?
In this episode of Kharcha Pani, we explain why crude oil prices are falling, the importance of the Strait of Hormuz, how cheaper oil could benefit India's economy, and why consumers may still have to wait for relief at petrol pumps.
Production: Anubhav Bajpai
Video Editor: Ved Prakash
